title: 26th October - Fourth Board Meeting
summary: The Fourth Board Meeting was held on 26th October 2026 from 6.30 pm onwards at Hindu Gymkhana and attended by 17 Office Bearers and Directors.
description: The Fourth Board Meeting was held on 26th October 2026 from 6.30 pm onwards at Hindu Gymkhana and attended by 17 Office Bearers and Directors. The Board Meeting was hosted by Rtn Suhit Jhaveri.
